facts: Fyre Festival takes place over two weekends in 2017: April 28 to April 30 and May 5 to May 7.
The festival location is on private islands in the Exumas on Fyre Cay.
Housing accommodations consist of luxurious tents equipped with charging stations and lights.
All ticket sales are final and there are no refunds.
Guests must bring a passport with an expiration date at least 6 months after departure.
Alcohol is not included in the ticket price but will be available for purchase for guests 21 and older.
